In rollouts 0, 2, and 3 the settlement commitments' detail text explicitly contains that exact phrase (e.g., rollout 0: "Ensure every modified print or digital item carries the exact attribution statement 'Adapted from OpenMath Core.'"), yet C5 still fails—this is an ENCODING MISMATCH, meaning the check is looking for the statement in a specific field or commitment type rather than in the free-text detail. In rollout 1 the commitment detail omits the exact phrase entirely ("Enter the OpenMath Core licensing note regarding the attribution requirement for modified materials into the library catalog record"), but since C5 fails even where the phrase is present, the root cause is the check's encoding expectation, not the model's output. C7 has no linked decisive facts and fails in all 4 rollouts, indicating it is either a structural/encoding mismatch or a misconfigured check unrelated to hidden-fact surfacing. No rollouts hit the turn cap; pacing is not a problem.
